verdict.rationale: Marketplace facilitator handling is a fair axis for sales tax compliance software. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers tracking facilitator-collected sales (Amazon, app stores) for nexus or excluding them from remittance. The Shopify recalculation note and the general nexus, filing and void features are adjacent capabilities and do not show marketplace facilitator modeling.

support.subject: As a finance lead, marketplace sales are modeled correctly — transactions where a facilitator (Amazon, app stores) collected the tax are tracked for nexus and reporting without being double-remitted
